name: tests-75pct-maroto-component-aware-render-layout-trace
instr:
Add a page-indexed component layout trace to generated Maroto documents.

Items have nonempty semantic identities/kinds, semantic values, nonnegative bounds/hierarchy positions, and final one-based pages. Preserve insertion order and distinct duplicate-sibling positions. Barcode, QR, and image items each record one operation; signatures record text and line as two operations in one item. Keep operation kinds distinct across these component types and isolate neighboring operations.

Barcodes, QR codes, file/byte images, and signatures implement `LayoutComponent`, with heights matching `GetHeight`. Honor barcode percentages, provider dimensions, file-image top displacement, configured-grid column widths, and signature font height, padding, and line thickness. File-image values expose paths without bytes; byte-image values distinguish images/extensions and remain unchanged after caller-buffer mutation. Invalid byte images retain their attempted operation/position without failing generation or leaking operations.

Existing components render once, receiving generic records with measured heights; custom descriptions supply kind/value. `Pages` lists final pages from one, with `Total` equal to page count and each item's `Page` matching its container, including automatic breaks. Trace registered headers/footers on every page. `Find` returns the matching item/true, or false for absent IDs.

Empty generation returns a non-nil empty trace. Repeated generation preserves counts, identities
